DESIGN DECISIONS A VERIFIER SHOULD KNOW: (a) THE REROUTE — region name-forms and the indicator number↔concept leg NO LONGER propose merges at all (the amendment's whole point: those pairs were identity-collapsing into thin merged pages; they are now composite candidates judged confirm/deny). The strict-identity indicator legs stay merge pairs. Pre-existing sticky merge records for such pairs are NOT migrated — the journalist's splits escape hatch dissolves them and the family returns as a cluster candidate (documented in wikis/AGENTS.md). (b) into ∈ members is REQUIRED (the composite takes a member's slug + folder — the merge precedent; validated on the raw entry before the member-order normalization, which is into-first-then-sorted for cross-run byte-stability). (c) A denied cluster keeps every member as its own page (it is NOT a merge); proposed-cluster members leave the open candidate list exactly like pair members, and a slug covered by both a proposed pair and a proposed cluster must be decided in exactly one (both-confirmed is a validation error). (d) The manual-edit veto for clusters is ALL-OR-NOTHING (a partial composite is never meaningful).
